whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Chatkara Kitchen,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews near Bairiya Bus Stand, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order/table booking, multicuisine menu showcase, aur location direction integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://chatkarakitchen-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Chatkara Kitchen team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Chatkara Kitchen - A Multicuisine Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, a multicuisine menu showcase, and easy Bairiya / Pahari location directions. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
